rules: PASS only where committed automated evidence proves it. SAFI alone issues formal acceptance. Missing evidence is not PASS.

build_machine_limits.openai: No OPENAI_API_KEY and no gpt-6-luna access on the build machine; every real-OpenAI check is BLOCKED, not simulated.
build_machine_limits.https: No owned domain/VM. npm run share:tunnel (Cloudflare quick tunnel) was verified to give a valid-TLS URL to a local stack; no permanent URL is recorded.
build_machine_limits.human: No independent non-developer session has taken place.
